annotations.title: Find and compare travel eSIM plans

description: Find the cheapest travel eSIM data plans for a trip: one country, a region, or several countries on the same trip (also_countries). Filter by trip length (trip_days), data needed (min_gb) and budget (max_price_usd); sort by price or price per GB. Each plan has its price in USD and price per GB, data (GB, or a daily high-speed allowance and the speed after it), validity in days, the hotspot / tethering rule, mobile networks, countries not covered and its simorago.com page. Use it to recommend, compare or price eSIMs for a trip, for what an unlimited plan's daily high-speed limit is and how slow it gets after it (throttled speed), or when someone asks how to get mobile data abroad without roaming charges.

also_countries.description: Other countries on the same trip, by name or ISO code. Only plans covering all of them are returned (Paris then Rome: destination France, also_countries ["Italy"]).

destination.description: Where the traveller is going: a country, region or city, by name or ISO code (Japan, JP, Italy, Europe, Tokyo). A country without plans of its own returns the regional plans that cover it.

limit.description: Most plans to return per destination. Default 10.

locale.description: Language for plan names, destination names and page links: en, es, de, fr, pt or he. Default en.

max_price_usd.description: Highest total price in US dollars.

min_gb.description: Least data needed, in GB. Daily-allowance plans always match.

sort.description: price (default, cheapest first) or price_per_gb (lowest price per GB of high-speed data first).

trip_days.description: Length of the trip in days. Returns only plans valid for at least this many days, so the plan lasts the whole trip.
